Jwt._Secret: NEVER commit the signing key. Set JWT__SECRET (env) or Jwt:Secret in appsettings.Local.json. The API refuses to start without a real one.

Encryption._: Application-layer encryption of JSON request/response bodies for the web app, on top of TLS. Retell webhooks and live-call tools, the platform endpoints, /health and Swagger are exempt by path and always speak plain JSON.
Encryption._Required: When true, non-exempt endpoints reject requests that arrive without an encrypted session. Leave false to keep Swagger and curl usable against a running API.

Platform._AdminKey: NEVER commit this. Shared secret the super admin console (AiReceptionist.SuperAdmin) presents in X-Platform-Key on /api/v1/platform/*. Set the same random value (32+ chars) here via appsettings.Local.json / PLATFORM__ADMINKEY and in the console. Without it the platform endpoints return 503.

Retell._ApiKey: NEVER commit the API key. Managed centrally in the database (SuperAdmin → Retell connection); appsettings.Local.json / Retell__ApiKey seed it on first run.

Stripe._SecretKey: NEVER commit the secret key. Set STRIPE__SECRETKEY (env) or Stripe:SecretKey in appsettings.Local.json. Without it billing screens still work, but nothing is collected automatically — payments have to be recorded by hand in the super admin console.
Stripe._WebhookSecret: NEVER commit this either. The signing secret Stripe shows when you add the endpoint (whsec_...). Without it every webhook delivery is rejected, so invoices and payments are never mirrored back.
Stripe._AppBaseUrl: Where Stripe returns the customer after Checkout or the billing portal. Defaults to the first Cors:AllowedOrigins entry.

Billing._: How often elapsed billing periods are totalled into OrganizationUsagePeriods. Stripe's invoice.created webhook also triggers a close, so this is the safety net rather than the main path.
